description: Import and Export Control Department - Regulation publishment by the Gazette Notifications passed by the Parliament by the powers vested in Hon. Minister of Finance and Planning under Import and Export (Control) Act
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the parliamentary approval of several previously issued Gazette Extraordinary notifications that amend import/export control regulations, ban/suspend specific imports, and modify HS codes for motor vehicles. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters involving amendments to existing laws and regulations under the Import and Export (Control) Act, making it primarily about legal framework and regulatory changes rather than government personnel, structure, or other specialized categories.
